verdict.rationale: Antigravity 2.0 is a downloadable desktop app with visual diff review: code-diff Artifacts, a Review Changes menu, and file diff viewers with a 'Hide Whitespace Changes' filter. It also documents running multiple agents in parallel from a central command center. However, the evidence never shows these sessions displayed side by side in the UI, and no hands-on report corroborates the diff-review experience. missing for 10: documented side-by-side multi-session layout or view, independent/hands-on corroboration of visual diff review and parallel sessions in the desktop app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Added a "Hide Whitespace Changes" option to the Review Changes overflow menu and file diff viewers to filter out whitespace-only edits.
Artifacts include rich markdown plans (Implementation Plans), code diffs, architecture diagrams, images, and browser recordings.
Orchestrate multiple autonomous agents working in parallel across independent projects.
Antigravity 2.0 serves as your AI agents’ central command center, providing a unified platform to launch, monitor, and orchestrate their activities.
